protocol.selection: Use all four quarterly evaluations of year y-2; all outcomes complete before Jan1 y
protocol.rule: Separate model only if all four past quarters exist, each n>=200/events>=20, and separate calibrated beats pooled calibrated on BOTH Brier/logloss in ALL four. Otherwise pooled.
protocol.scope: All saved quarters; no per-result threshold tuning; unavailable separate models fall back to pooled
protocol.limitations: Rule proposed after inspecting past project results; retrospective analysis, not pristine holdout. Not operational validation.
